cc:Work.dc:title: Flip and Arrange Shoe simulation
cc:Work.dc:description: Extracted success rates. Dense Sampling has only one available evaluation (5,000 dataset steps). No later checkpoints are inferred. Additional temporary base/finetuned comparisons are extracted separately. They have no dataset-budget labels and are not combined with the v20 learning curve.
